description_of_change_order: Section III. A. 2nd paragraph - the first sentence is to be changed to read as follows: Twenty-four to 30 hours prior to dosing, both eyes of each rabbit will be examined by an experienced investigator using a slit lamp biomicroscope. The change was made so the protocol more closely conforms with the proposed regulations as stated in the Federal Register, Vol. 44, No. 145, 772.112-24 Primary Eye Irritation Study.
